exposure: B and T cell repertoire metrics (somatic hypermutation, clonality, diversity, richness)
inadequately low T cell repertoire diversity
Low antigen-dependent somatic hypermutation of B cell repertoires
high thymic and bone marrow output
breadth of the T cell repertoire
low T and B cell repertoire clonality
high richness especially in public T cell clonotypes
cohort: 120 infants from the LoewenKIDS birth cohort
finding: Infants with low T cell repertoire diversity or high clonality experienced a higher number of acute respiratory infections over the first four years of life.
mod_finding: No correlation was found between T or B cell repertoire metrics and birth mode.
